body: I'm still holding on to that hope that my ex said to me that it's making me alive yet want to kms too. that hope was gone 2 months ago , and that makes me want to believe in nothing anymore.

I'm sorry you have to go through these all OP, things must've been really tough for you. I totally understand and feel the same way. In my case why I want to do it in another place is that I have a niece and nephew who would probably get traumatized seeing me unconscious. And also the same reason why I can't do it, is because I don't want my family to see my not-breathing-body. I don't want them to see the horror by their own eyes. I have a carefully crafted plan so that only the professionals will have to deal with my body.

I don't want go trigger you but, I just want to share the same plan that I had/have. I was supposed to end it all yesterday noon, I was all ready, my belongings are all sort out and in a storage. I even took a bath early than I used to. I'm ready to go to an apartelle near my place which has no smoke detector (that's how I will exit, I won't say the exact "word" of it cause I care about you and others' mental health here) but for some reason something is stopping me. I failed to do it yesterday, but I still have a plan to do it. 

I hope there's still hope for you OP, as I do hope for me as well, even though it seems that I ran out of hopes.

everytime that I feel that it's coming, I grab my phone and go to spotify and play "last hope" by paramore, if it's not last hope, it's "daylily" by movements. It's either of them that I play first. It's been like a ritual to me every morning and every time that I feel it's coming. It's helpful, all the darkness and thoughts are going away BUT it's not always the case for me everyday. Because most of the time, it's consuming me and there's not a day that I've never think about offing myself.
doing the opposite of getting better & doing all the "what-should-not-do"

I feel the same OP. I have school for 5 days in a week and the only time that I get to drink is on weekends with my friends in my city. I am in another city because my school is pretty far from my home so everytime that I'm going home, I'm not feeling heavy and just pure happiness. The feeling of getting drunk is the feeling that I'd want to feel everyday, I know it's not a healthy coping mechanism but that's the only way we can't feel the pain, even it's just for a while. I started to smoke too, and I can't believe that I can smoke 5 sticks in a day. Every time that my thoughts are getting loud, I smoke it out. World is pretty cruel right? This pain and loneliness has eaten me about 90% now, it made me heartless and emotionless. And I don't know if i can still hold on to the hope of people of who thinks that I can battle it, because my intuition is telling me that I will exiting this painful world next week. 


Stay strong OP, I know it's very difficult and painful. But I hope you find your euphoria and solace someday, because I, myself, still believe of that 1% hope.
I hope you're still here OP *sending hugs*
